newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T Industries up ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T Industries up ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries advanced late on Monday on speculative buying ahead of the group's results on Wednesday, dealers said.
By 1613 GMT, the shares were up 8-1/2p to 545-1/2 on trading volume of 7.4 million shares, making them among the most actively traded in London.

The British conglomerate, which manufacturers cigarettes and operates financial and insurance services, is set to release its results on Wednesday. Dealers said news that Philip Morris Cos Inc won access to the names of 400,000 Medicaid patients to help its challenge to the financial claims of the state of Florida boosted Philip Morris shares, which in turn, supported B.A.T shares.
A strong UK insurance sector, plus a depreciation of sterling against the dollar also helped the shares, they said.
